pathya_apathya: Pathya: Mother's milk, light rice gruel (Laja Peya), boiled water. Apathya: Heavy cow/buffalo milk, cold food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 2 (p. 506); Chakradatta Balarogachikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Balarogadhikara
safety_check: Do not use honey in infants under 12 months (use expressed breast milk or warm water as vehicle instead)

condition_name: Sciatica, Lumbar Spondylosis & Radiating Leg Pain (Gridhrasi & Kati-Graha)
remedy_name: Nirgundi-Dashamoola Kwath & Lashuna Ksheerapaka (Garlic Milk)
remedy_text: 1) Lashuna Ksheerapaka: Boil 3-4 crushed cloves of Lahsun (garlic) in 100 ml milk and 400 ml water until reduced to 100 ml milk; strain and drink warm once daily in the morning or at bedtime. 2) Nirgundi-Dashamoola Kwath: Take 20 ml decoction of Dashamoola and Nirgundi (Vitex negundo) leaves with 5 ml Eranda Taila (castor oil) at bedtime.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 16, p. 415 & Ch. 23 Vatavyadhi Chikitsa) and Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa). Garlic cooked in milk (Ksheerapaka) buffers its तीक्ष्ण/उष्ण irritation while delivering potent Vatahara and nerve-soothing action along the sciatic nerve (Kandara).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, garlic, castor oil purgation (Mridu Virechana), Kati Basti / warm oil massage. Apathya: Lifting heavy weights, sitting on hard cold surfaces, chickpeas/peas.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 16 (p. 415) & Ch. 23; Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 15
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (Eranda Taila) and active Peptic Ulcer
keywords: lower back pain radiating to leg

condition_name: Physical & Sexual Debility, Fatigue & Tissue Depletion (Dhatukshaya & Klaibya)
remedy_name: Ashwagandha-Shatavari-Kapikacchu Ksheerapaka with Ghee & Madhu
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) root powder and/or Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) powder cooked in 150 ml warm milk with 1 tsp cow's Ghee and 1 tsp sugar/misri twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 24, p. 144: 'Ashwagandhavidaryadya vrishyashchaushadhayo hitah' & Uttarasthana Ch. 50 Vajikarana, p. 733-738), Ashwagandha, Vidari, Shatavari, and Amalaki with milk and ghee are the premier Brimhana (tissue-building), Balya, and Vrishya Rasayanas.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, almonds, dates (Kharjura), black gram (Masha) soup, adequate sleep. Apathya: Excessive fasting, dry/bitter/astringent foods, mental anxiety.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 24 (p. 144) & Uttarasthana Ch. 50 (p. 733-738)
safety_check: Avoid high-dose Ashwagandha in Pregnancy; omit sugar in Diabetes

condition_name: Chronic Eczema, Psoriasis, Boils & Non-Healing Skin Lesions (Kushtha & Pidika)
remedy_name: Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu / Khadirarishta & Aragwadhadi Kwath
remedy_text: 1) Decoction: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from Khadira bark (Acacia catechu), Nimba, Patola, Guduchi, Vasa, and Triphala; take twice daily. 2) Classical: Khadirarishta (15-20 ml with equal water after meals) or Panchatikta Ghrita (5-10 ml with warm water).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Khadirah kushthaghnanam' & Chikitsasthana Ch. 21 Kushtha Chikitsa, p. 433-438), Khadira is the supreme herb for all skin diseases (Kushtha), clearing deep Rakta-Mamsa-Meda vitiation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Old rice, Moong dal, bitter gourd, Neem, Triphala. Apathya: Milk with fish/salt/sour fruits (Viruddha Ahara), curd, urad dal, jaggery, sesame.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98) & Chikitsasthana Ch. 21 (p. 433-438)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy

condition_name: Prophylaxis Against Recurrent Common Cold (Pratishyaya Prevention)
remedy_name: Morning Adrak (Fresh Ginger) Decoction
remedy_text: Take 10 ml warm decoction prepared from a small piece of fresh ginger (Adrak) every morning on an empty stomach to prevent recurrent attacks of cold.
ayurvedic_note: Regular morning intake of Ardraka kindles Agni and prevents Kapha accumulation in the head and chest during seasonal transitions (Ritusandhi).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water bath, light breakfast. Apathya: Morning cold water exposure, curd.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 1 (Adrak/Sonth)
safety_check: Avoid in active Peptic Ulcer / severe Hyperacidity

condition_name: Subacute Cold & Cough with Sore Throat (Kapha-Vata Kasa)
remedy_name: Sonth-Guda (Dry Ginger & Jaggery) Bolus
remedy_text: Mix 2-5 gm powder of dry ginger (Sonth) with old Jaggery (Guda) and take thrice a day in divided doses.
ayurvedic_note: Guda softens the throat and binds the pungent Sunthi powder, providing sustained Kapha-Vata shamana and expectoration.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water. Apathya: Cold drinks, fried foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 1 (Adrak/Sonth)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Diabetes (Guda) and severe Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer (Sonth)

condition_name: Productive Cough with Thick Sputum (Kaphaja Kasa)
remedy_name: Lahsun (Garlic) Boiled Water with Sugar or Honey
remedy_text: Boil a crushed bulb/cloves of Lahsun (Allium sativum / Garlic) in water, strain, and take warm with a little sugar; OR take 6 ml fresh garlic juice mixed with honey twice a day.
ayurvedic_note: Rasona (garlic) has Tikshna, Ushna, and Kapha-chedana properties that cut through thick, sticky bronchial mucus in Kaphaja Kasa and asthma.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light food. Apathya: Cold dairy, sweets.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 15 (Lahsun)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer and Infants under 1 year (Honey)

condition_name: Chronic Pruritus, Eczema & Allergic Skin Conditions (Kandu & Kushtha)
remedy_name: Bhuna Jeera (Fried Cumin) with Warm Milk
remedy_text: Take 1-2 gm powder of fried Jeera (Cuminum cyminum) with warm milk twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Digestive Ama and Pitta-Kapha vitiation underlie many chronic skin allergies. Jiraka with milk corrects Agni while gently cooling Pitta in the Rakta Dhatu.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Light, non-spicy diet. Apathya: Fermented, sour, salty foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 12 (Jeera)
safety_check: 100% Safe across all patients including Pregnancy and Gastritis

condition_name: Anorexia & Loss of Appetite with Bloating (Vata-Kapha Aruchi)
remedy_name: Hing-Jeera Churna with Ghee
remedy_text: Mix a pinch of fried Hing (asafoetida) and 1 gm roasted Jeera (cumin) powder with 1 tsp Ghee (clarified butter) and take with warm food at the start of meals.
ayurvedic_note: Ghee stimulates Samana Vata and Pachaka Pitta without increasing dryness, while Hingu and Jiraka clear Kapha-Vata obstruction in the gut.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm rice/roti, moong dal. Apathya: Cold water with meals.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 8 (Ghee)
safety_check: Avoid Hing in Pregnancy

condition_name: Chronic Indigestion, Flatulence & Sluggish Bowel (Mandagni)
remedy_name: Roasted Saunf-Kalimirach Takra (Spiced Fennel Buttermilk)
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm powder of roasted Saunf (fennel seeds) mixed in a glass of fresh buttermilk (Takra) with a little black pepper powder and rock salt twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Shatapushpa (Saunf) and Takra restore Agni, prevent post-meal drowsiness (Bhuktajadya), and clear intestinal gas.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Daytime buttermilk after lunch. Apathya: Curd at night.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 24 (Saunf)
safety_check: Omit salt in severe Hypertension

condition_name: Delirium, Drowsiness & Severe Toxic Fever (Sannipata Jwara — Emergency Adjunctive)
remedy_name: Bhunimbadi Ashtadashanga Kwath & Brihat Katphaladi Kwath
remedy_text: Classical hospital/Vaidya decoction prepared from Bhunimba (Kiratatikta), Devadaru, Dashamoola, Shunthi, Musta, Katuki, Indrayava, Dhanyaka, and Gajapippali (20 ml warm with Pippali powder). NOTE: Altered mental status, drowsiness, neck stiffness, or breathlessness in fever is a RED-TIER EMERGENCY requiring immediate hospital/108 transfer!
ayurvedic_note: Documented in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 146-151, p. 52-53) for Tridoshaja Sannipata fevers complicated by respiratory congestion, parotitis (Karnamoola Shotha), and stupor.
pathya_apathya: Immediate hospital referral required for Red-Tier Sannipata symptoms.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 146-151 (p. 52-53)
safety_check: RED-TIER WARNING: Any fever with stupor/delirium/breathlessness must be referred immediately to emergency care

condition_name: Chronic Low-Grade Fever with Cough, Night Sweats & Emaciation (Jirna Jwara & Kshaya)
remedy_name: Pippalyadi Ghrita &vasa-Guduchi Kwath
remedy_text: 1) Vasa-Guduchi Kwath: 20 ml decoction of Vasa, Guduchi, Triphala, Trayamana, and Yavasaka twice daily. 2) Pippalyadi Ghrita: Medicated cow's Ghee cooked with Pippali, Chandana, Musta, Ushira, Katuki, Kalingaka, Amalaki, Sariva, Ativisha, Sthira, Draksha, and Trayamana (5-10 gm with warm milk/water).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 2 Jirnajwara Chikitsa, p. 330: 'Dehadhatvabalatvena jwaro jirno anuvartate') and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 262-265, p. 81-82), chronic fever persists due to Dhatu depletion and Vata-Pitta dryness; medicated Ghritas (Sarpih-pana) and milk (Ksheera) nourish Dhatus and extinguish deep-seated fever.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, medicated ghee, old Shali rice, Moong soup. Apathya: Fasting (Langhana is contraindicated in Jirna/Kshaya Jwara!), dry/spicy food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 2 (p. 330); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 262-265 (p. 81-82)
safety_check: Note: Chronic fever >2 weeks with weight loss/night sweats requires PHC sputum/TB (Nikshay) screening!

condition_name: Chronic Colitis, Ulcerative Colitis & Mucoid Dysentery (Sangrahani & Raktatisara)
remedy_name: Kutajashtaka Avaleha / Brihat Kutajavaleha
remedy_text: Prepared by boiling 100 Palas of Kutaja bark in water down to 1/4th, straining, and cooking to a thick linctus (Avaleha) with powdered Patha, Samanga (Lajjalu), Ativisha, Musta, Bilva pulp, Dhataki flowers, Shalmali exudate (Mocharasa), and Kutaja seeds. Take 5-10 gm twice daily with buttermilk, goat's milk, or water.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 10, p. 385), Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Atisaradhikara v. 83-86, p. 294), and Chakradatta (p. 34). Heals mucosal ulcerations in the colon, stops bleeding, and cures all types of Atisara, Grahani, and bleeding Arsha.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, rice gruel, pomegranate. Apathya: Spicy, sour, heavy foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 (p. 385); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikara v. 83-86 (p. 294); Chakradatta (p. 34)
safety_check: Safe for chronic colitis and dysentery

condition_name: Rectal Prolapse, Tenesmus & Severe Dysentery Pain (Gudabhransha & Pravahika)
remedy_name: Bilvadi Yoga & Madhvadhi Yoga with Takra
remedy_text: Take equal parts of unripe Bilva pulp, Musta, Dhataki flowers, Patha, Shunthi, and Mocharasa (5 gm total) with buttermilk (Takra) and jaggery twice daily. For rectal prolapse (Gudabhransha), apply warm Bala Taila or Changeryadi Ghrita locally and perform gentle sitz bath.
ayurvedic_note: From Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Atisaradhikara v. 58 & 65-66, p. 287 & 289) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 11, p. 391). Relieves severe straining (Pravahana) and tones the pelvic floor and rectal sphincter.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Soft gruels, buttermilk, avoiding straining at stool. Apathya: Dry, hard foods, squatting for long periods.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikara v. 58 & 65-66 (p. 287, 289); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 11 (p. 391)
safety_check: Seek medical evaluation at PHC if rectal prolapse is irreducible

condition_name: Chronic Malabsorption, Celiac/Sprue-like Diarrhoea & Edema (Grahani & Shotha)
remedy_name: Takrarishta (Classical Medicated Fermented Buttermilk)
remedy_text: Prepared by fermenting fresh buttermilk (Takra) with fine powders of Yavani (Ajvain), Amalaki, Haritaki, Maricha, and five Lavanas (or Hapusha, Dhanyaka, Jeeraka, Chitraka, Pippali, Shunthi) for 7-10 days until sour-pungent. Take 15-30 ml after meals twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 12 Grahani Chikitsa, p. 395: 'Esha takrarishtah param dipano arshogulmajatharashwayathukrimipramehaharah'), Bhaishajya Ratnavali (p. 325), and Chakradatta (p. 42). Rich in natural probiotics and Agni-deepana herbs, it cures Grahani, piles, edema, and worm infestations.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Light rice and buttermilk diet. Apathya: Heavy milk products, fried food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 12 (p. 395); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Grahanyadhikara v. 152-153 (p. 325); Chakradatta (p. 42)
safety_check: Avoid in severe Hyperacidity/Ulcer and uncontrolled Hypertension (contains Lavana)

condition_name: Menopause Hot Flashes, Burning Sensation & Irritability (Rajonivritti Janya Daha)
remedy_name: Shatavari-Amalaki Ksheerapaka & Ushira-Chandana Hima
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) root powder and 2 gm Amla powder with a cup of warm or cool milk twice daily. For facial pigmentation (melasma), apply Jayphal rubbed in milk externally.
ayurvedic_note: Shatavari is Madhura, Sheeta, Rasayana, and balances the Vata-Pitta transition of Rajonivritti (menopause), relieving hot flashes (Daha), dryness, and irritability.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, pomegranate, Amla, coconut water, cooling pranayama (Sheetali). Apathya: Spicy, sour, hot foods, caffeine.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 7); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4 & 11
safety_check: 100% Safe for menopausal women

condition_name: Cervical Spondylosis, Shoulder Pain & Brachial Neuralgia (Manyastambha & Avabahuka)
remedy_name: Rasnasaptaka Kwath & Dashamoola-Bala Taila Abhyanga
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata), Guduchi, Aragwadha, Devadaru, Gokshura, Eranda moola, and Punarnava (Rasnasaptaka Kwath); take warm twice daily with 1/2 tsp ginger juice. 2) External: Gently massage neck and shoulder with warm Mahanarayana Taila or Bala Taila followed by warm dry fomentation (Ruksha/Nadi Sweda).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Rasna vataharanam') and Chikitsasthana Ch. 23, Rasna is declared the #1 Vata-pacifying herb in the entire Materia Medica.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Proper neck posture, warm water, garlic, gentle neck exercises. Apathya: High pillows (Uchcha-upadhana), cold wind exposure, suppressing sneeze/yawn urges.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98) & Chikitsasthana Ch. 23; Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa
safety_check: Safe across adult populations

condition_name: Mouth Ulcers & Stomatitis (Mukhapaka / Sarvasara Mukharoga)
remedy_name: Triphala-Madhu Kavala (Gargle), Mulethi-Ghee Lepa & Nariyal Pani
remedy_text: 1) Topical & Gargle: Gargle 3-4 times daily with a cooled decoction of Triphala or Jati (Jasmine) leaves or Anar rind mixed with 1 tsp Honey (Madhu), OR apply pure cow's Ghee / Honey directly over the mouth ulcers. 2) Internal: Drink tender coconut water (Nariyal pani) and take 3 gm Amla powder with milk at bedtime to clear Pitta from the gut.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 26 Mukharoga Pratishedha, p. 600: 'Mukhapakeshu samanyatas triphalakwatho madhuman'), Triphala Kwath with honey and Ghee rapidly heals Pittaja-Raktaja aphthous ulcers.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Bland, cooling diet, milk, ghee, coconut water. Apathya: Spicy chilies, hot tea/coffee, sour pickles, betel nut/tobacco.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 26 (p. 600); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 8, 17, 19
safety_check: 100% Safe across all patients (avoid honey in infants <1 year)

condition_name: Dysuria, Burning Urination & Cystitis (Pittaja Mutrakricchra)
remedy_name: Trinapanchamoola Kwath / Shatavari-Gokshura-Amalaki Hima
remedy_text: Prepare a cold infusion or cooled decoction (20-30 ml) from equal parts of Gokshura, Shatavari, Amalaki, Ushira (Khus), and Dhania seeds with 1 tsp Misri (rock candy). Drink twice or thrice daily alongside tender coconut water.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 13 Mutraghata Chikitsa, p. 400). Alkalizes acidic urine, cools Pitta in the Mutravaha Srotas, and relieves burning micturition (Sadaha Mutrata).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Plenty of water, coconut water, cucumber, ash gourd, barley water. Apathya: Alcohol, spicy/sour/salty foods, holding urine.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 13 (p. 400); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 6, 19
safety_check: 100% Safe in Pregnancy, Hypertension, and Gastritis; omit Misri in Diabetes

condition_name: Thrombosed or Painful Swollen External Piles (Sashoola/Sashotha Arsha)
remedy_name: Haridra-Ghee / Kumari (Aloe Vera) External Lepa & Triphala Sitz Bath
remedy_text: 1) Sitz Bath (Avagaha Sweda): Sit in a tub of warm water mixed with Triphala decoction and a pinch of Tankana (borax) or rock salt for 10-15 minutes twice daily. 2) Local Paste: Apply a smooth paste of Haldi (turmeric) powder mixed with cow's Ghee (or fresh Aloe vera pulp) over the external pile mass after defecation.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 Arsha Chikitsa, p. 380) and Chakradatta (Arshachikitsa, p. 45). Warm Avagaha Sweda and Haridra-Ghrita Lepa relieve sphincter spasm, reduce venous engorgement, and soothe pain.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, fiber-rich diet, warm sitz bath. Apathya: Straining, sitting on hard seats, spicy food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 (p. 380); Chakradatta Arshachikitsa (p. 45); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 8-9
safety_check: 100% Safe external therapy across all patients including Pregnancy

condition_name: Hemicrania, Migraine & Sunrise-to-Sunset Headache (Ardhavabhedaka & Suryavarta)
remedy_name: Pathyadi Kwath & Goghrita / Anu Taila Pratimarsha Nasya
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction of Pathyadi Kwath — equal parts of Pathya (Haritaki), Vibhitaki, Amalaki, Bhunimba (Kiratatikta), Haridra (Turmeric), Nimba bark, and Guduchi (Giloy); take twice daily with a little jaggery or honey. 2) Nasal Instillation (Nasya): Instill 2 drops of lukewarm pure cow's Ghee (or Shadbindu/Anu Taila) into each nostril in the morning.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 27-28 Shiroroga Vijnaniya & Pratishedha, p. 602-605) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Shirorogadhikara), Ardhavabhedaka (migraine) and Suryavarta (sinus/vascular headache peaking at noon) respond specifically to Pathyadi Kwath and Sneha Nasya ('Nasa hi shiraso dwaram' — the nose is the gateway to the head).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Regular meals, cow's ghee, milk, pomegranate, adequate sleep. Apathya: Fasting/skipping meals, bright sun exposure, fermented/sour foods, night vigil.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 28 (p. 604-605); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Shirorogadhikara
safety_check: Avoid oral Haritaki in Pregnancy (use Ghee Nasya and Amla-Takra forehead paste instead)

condition_name: Post-Viral Arthralgia & Chikungunya/Dengue Recovery Joint Pain (Sandhigata Jwara)
remedy_name: Guduchi-Rasnadi Kwath (Giloy, Rasna, Eranda, Devadaru & Ginger Decoction)
remedy_text: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from equal parts of Guduchi (Giloy), Rasna, Shunthi (dry ginger), Devadaru, and Dashamoola. Take warm twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 104-107, p. 42) and Ashtanga Sangraha. Clears residual Jwara-Ama lodged in the joints (Parvabheda/Sandhishoola) and restores joint mobility.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light soups, rest. Apathya: Cold water, sour curds, heavy beans.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 104-107 (p. 42)
safety_check: Safe across adult groups

condition_name: Chronic Allergic Rhinitis, Urticaria & Recurrent Skin Allergy (Shitapitta & Pratishyaya)
remedy_name: Haridra Khanda (Classical Turmeric Anti-Allergic Granules)
remedy_text: Classical granule formulation prepared from Haridra (Turmeric - 8 parts), cow's Ghee (6 parts), cow's Milk, Sugar, and fine powders of Trikatu, Trijata, Vidanga, Trivrit, Triphala, Nagakesara, Musta, and Lauha Bhasma. Take 3-5 gm twice daily with warm milk.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Shitapitta-Udarda-Kothadhikara) as the premier classical formulation for chronic urticaria (Shitapitta), pruritus (Kandu), allergic rhinitis, and fungal skin infections (Dadru).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm milk, light wholesome diet. Apathya: Cold wind/water, incompatible foods, fish, curd.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Shitapitta-Udarda-Kothadhikara; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 9 (Haldi)
safety_check: Contraindicated in uncontrolled Diabetes (contains Sharkara) and Pregnancy (contains Trivrit)

condition_name: Fatty Liver, Hepatomegaly, Splenomegaly & Ascites Support (Yakrit-Pliha Vriddhi)
remedy_name: Rohitakarishta /Rohitakadi Kwath & Pippali-Haritaki Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Pippali-Haritaki Yoga: Take 1-2 gm equal parts of Pippali and Haritaki powder with a little old jaggery (Guda) or warm water twice daily. 2) Classical: Rohitakarishta (prepared from Rohitaka bark, Triphala, Trikatu, Trijata, Chavya, Chitraka) 15-20 ml with equal water after meals.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 17 Udara Chikitsa, p. 422) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Rohitaka and Pippali-Haritaki clear Kapha-Pitta congestion in the liver (Yakrit) and spleen (Pliha).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, old barley/rice, light diet. Apathya: Alcohol, heavy fats, daytime sleep.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 17 (p. 422); Chakradatta Plihayakrillikitsa
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy

condition_name: Spasmodic Abdominal Colic, Renal Colic & Bloating (Shoola & Gulma)
remedy_name: Lavanabhaskara Churna (Classical Carminative & Digestive Salt Formula)
remedy_text: Composed of Samudra Lavana, Sauvarchala Lavana, Vida Lavana, Saindhava Lavana, Dhanyaka, Pippali, Pippalimoola, Krishna Jeeraka, Nagakesara, Talisa, Amlavetasa, Maricha, Jeeraka, Shunthi, Dadima (pomegranate seeds), Tvak, and Ela. Take 2-3 gm with buttermilk or warm water after meals.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Grahanychikitsa / Shoolachikitsa) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali. Rapidly relieves Vata-Kapha abdominal colic, splenic pain, bloating, constipation, and indigestion.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, warm water. Apathya: Cold, dry, heavy legumes.
source: Chakradatta Grahanychikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandyadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN HYPERTENSION (High Sodium/Lavana content) and Hyperacidity/Ulcer

condition_name: Bone Fracture Healing, Osteoporosis & Ligament Sprain (Asthibhanga & Asthikshaya)
remedy_name: Asthishrinkhala (Hadjod) & Arjuna-Laksha Ksheerapaka with Ghee
remedy_text: Take 3 gm powder of Asthishrinkhala (Cissus quadrangularis / Hadjod) stem or Arjuna bark with 1 tsp cow's Ghee in a cup of warm milk twice daily. Also include garlic (Lahsun) paste with honey/food to accelerate bone union (Sandhanakara).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 7, p. 55: 'Bhagnasandhanakrit... lashunah' & Uttarasthana Ch. 32 Bhagna Pratishedha, p. 625), Lashuna, Arjuna, Laksha, and Madhura-Snigdha milk/ghee promote rapid callus formation (Asthi-sandhana).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, wheat, Shali rice, meat soup/moong soup, rest/immobilization. Apathya: Salt, sour, pungent, dry foods, physical strain on injured limb.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 7 (p. 55) & Uttarasthana Ch. 32 (p. 625-627); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 170-171 (p. 58-59: Asthikarkata/Hadjod)
safety_check: Always ensure proper orthopedic splinting/X-ray at PHC for suspected fractures!

condition_name: Night Blindness, Dry Eyes & Progressive Vision Weakness (Naktandhya, Shushkakshipaka & Timira)
remedy_name: Jeevanti-Agastya Patra Ghrita & Mahatraiphala Ghrita
remedy_text: 1) Dietary Remedy: Cook fresh Jeevanti (Leptadenia reticulata) leaves or Agastya leaves/flowers or Moringa (Shigru) leaves in cow's Ghee and include in daily meals; take 3-5 gm Triphala Churna with Ghee and Honey at night. 2) Classical: Mahatraiphala Ghrita (5 ml with warm milk at bedtime).
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 16 Timira Pratishedha, p. 558 & 561: 'Jivantyah pallavani cha bhakshayet'). Rich in natural beta-carotene (Vitamin A) and Chakshushya lipids, curing night blindness (Naktandhya) and dry eye syndrome.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cow's ghee, Triphala, Jeevanti, Amla, green leafy vegetables, foot massage with ghee. Apathya: Sour foods, night vigil, smoke/dust.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 16 (p. 558, 561); Chakradatta Netrarogachikitsa
safety_check: Avoid oral Triphala in Pregnancy; dietary Jeevanti/Ghee is 100% safe

condition_name: Infant/Child Abdominal Colic & Gas Distension (Bala Udara Shoola & Adhmana)
remedy_name: External Hing (Asafoetida) Warm Navel Paste (Nabhi Lepa)
remedy_text: Take a pinch of Hing (Ferula narthex / Asafoetida), stir and dissolve in a teaspoon of warm water to make a thin paste, and apply externally on and around the child's umbilicus (navel) in a circular motion.
ayurvedic_note: Specifically highlighted in CCRAS Ayurvedic Home Remedies (p. 10: 'Specially in children or infants where there is abdominal distention this is very helpful') and Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 2). Transdermal absorption around the Nabhi (seat of Samana Vata and Agni) relieves infantile colic without oral irritation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Gentle clockwise tummy massage, burping baby after feeds. Apathya: Mother consuming gas-forming foods (chana, rajma, cold water) while breastfeeding.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 10 (Hing); Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 2
safety_check: 100% Safe external application for infants and children of all ages
